sentences.en: Influenza, measles, pox and chickenpox are infectious and contagious diseases.
sentences.zh: 流感、麻疹、天花和水痘都是传染性疾病。

sentences.en: You were flat on your back for two weeks with influenza.
High fever is a frequent accompaniment of influenza.
sentences.zh: 高烧是流感常见的伴随症状。

senses.zh: [内科] 流行性感冒（简写flu）；家畜流行性感冒
